propositions: make lint and make typecheck are executed twice in CI: once as direct named steps and again when pre-commit run --all-files re-invokes the lint and typecheck hooks
The redundant double-execution wastes CI resources while maintaining the same coverage, since both execution paths invoke identical Makefile targets
OSS best practices (pydantic, home-assistant, pandas, scikit-learn) run each linter exactly once through a single mechanism, not redundantly
Adding lint and typecheck to the SKIP env variable in both CI workflows will eliminate the redundant pre-commit re-run while preserving local git commit linting via unchanged .pre-commit-config.yaml
A regression guard test must verify that the CI pre-commit step skips lint and typecheck in both workflow files to prevent the double-run from silently returning
